name: @tweakcad/mcp-bridge
instructions: These tools edit the document open in a TweakCAD tab. Call cad_help first: it explains the document, handles (names for bodies, faces, edges and sketch regions, from the list_* tools and get_sketch), units and worked examples. Group a change of several steps between begin_transaction and end_transaction so the user can undo it at once.
